_doc: Crews. id is the byte stored in the paint atlas (0 = neutral). side A spawns at maps[].spawns.A. Colors are sRGB hex. 'mark' is the colorblind-safe SHAPE shown with every team color (crests, minimap, kill feed, HUD).

colorblind._doc: Settings → Colorblind marks. Swaps to a max-separation pair and adds a diagonal hatch to GULF CREW dye in the surface shader.
